transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because for the last couple of years, I just feel low all the time. It's like, even when I'm at work, or at church, or around people I care about, there's just this heavy, empty feeling. It just doesn't really ever lift.
Over these past couple of years, has this low, empty feeling been present continuously every day, or have there been stretches of weeks or months where your mood returned to normal?

It's been pretty much every day. I haven't really had any stretches where I felt normal again. 

Um, it's actually been going on for about two years and four months now. I know because it started right around the time I had to stop taking my community-college classes. I just didn't have the money for it anymore, and it was getting too hard to balance with my work schedule. But yeah, it's been continuous since then.
Along with this low mood, have you also been experiencing things like significant changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness nearly every day?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely changed. Um, I'll be completely exhausted after standing on the production floor all day, but when I finally get in bed, my mind just keeps running about everything I'm behind on. And then, if I do actually manage to fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested at all.
Over these past two years, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends and family?

No, I wouldn't say I've lost interest. I still like going to church and, you know, seeing my family. It's just that even when I'm doing those things, I still have that heavy feeling I mentioned. I still want to do them, it's just hard to feel fully there.

During these past two years, has there ever been a period of at least two weeks where your mood or other symptoms became noticeably worse or more intense than your usual baseline—for example, more severe fatigue, hopelessness, or difficulty functioning at work?
No, I don't think so. It's just been the same heavy feeling the whole time. I haven't really noticed any periods where it got worse than usual, it's just always there.
